content.text:
**The most prominent Cloudflare Workers-related incident report is from the major service outage on June 12, 2025.**[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

### Key Details from the Official Post-Mortem
- **Date and Duration**: The outage began around 17:52 UTC on June 12, 2025, and lasted **2 hours and 28 minutes**, affecting global services.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)
- **Affected Services**: Workers KV (primary cause), WARP, Access, Gateway, Images, Stream, Workers AI, Turnstile and Challenges, AutoRAG, Zaraz, parts of the Cloudflare Dashboard, and indirectly Workers / Workers for Platforms (error rates peaked at ~2% for standard Workers and ~10% for Workers for Platforms).[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)
- **Root Cause**: A failure in the underlying storage infrastructure for **Workers KV**, which serves as a critical dependency for configuration, authentication, and asset delivery across many Cloudflare products. Part of this infrastructure relied on a third-party cloud provider that experienced an outage. Workers KV depends on a central data store for cold reads/writes; a gap in resilient infrastructure coverage was exposed.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)
- **Impact on Workers KV**: Approximately **90.22% of requests failed** (returning 503 or 500 errors) for any key-value pairs not served from cache that required origin storage backend access. Cached requests (200/404) and some errors within budget were unaffected. No data was lost, and it was not caused by an attack.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)
- **Cloudflare's Acknowledgment**: The company took full responsibility, noting that while the trigger was a third-party vendor failure, they are accountable for dependencies and architecture. They are transitioning Workers KV to more resilient infrastructure.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

You can read the full detailed incident report here: [Cloudflare service outage June 12, 2025](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/).[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

### Other Recent or Related Workers Incidents
Smaller, more contained issues have been reported on Cloudflare's status page and community forums, including:
- **February 2024**: Logs dropped for a small subset of Workers (Logpush issue); quickly resolved.[[2]](https://community.cloudflare.com/t/cloudflare-workers-issues/621958)
- **October 2025**: Increased 1022 errors for some Workers scripts; resolved the same day.[[3]](https://community.cloudflare.com/t/cloudflare-workers-issues/842539)
- **August 2026**: Multiple brief incidents, such as increased errors for Workers KV requests, Workers AI model errors, Workers and Pages asset upload issues, and Workers Runtime API problems (all resolved within hours).[[4]](https://statusfield.com/services/cloudflare/incidents)

For ongoing or real-time status, check [Cloudflare's status page](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/) or the [incident history aggregator](https://statusfield.com/services/cloudflare/incidents).[[4]](https://statusfield.com/services/cloudflare/incidents)

If you're looking for a specific date, product (e.g., Workers KV, D1, or AI), or type of report (e.g., security, performance, or abuse reporting unrelated to outages), provide more details for a more targeted search.
